crossRefs.note: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all…
Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
